attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Psychology (RI Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs relevant to psychology sponsored or approved by APA or the RI Psychological Association, other recognized psychological organizations and national/state associations of licensed mental health professions, state nurses associations, state medical societies or medical schools with APA-approved postdoctoral programs; postdoctoral coursework from regionally accredited colleges; other Board-approved agencies
rules.new_licensee_rule: Psychologists initially licensed by examination after the July 1 renewal date are exempt until the next renewal cycle.
rules.audit_note: Random audit by the Department; keep documentation for at least four years from the renewal date.
rules.notes: CE cycle July 1 - June 30 of even-numbered years; renewal due on or before July 1 of even years. Internet, correspondence and recorded courses are acceptable. No mandatory topic hours in the rule.
rules.rule_quote: The application for license renewal shall include a signed statement attesting to the satisfactory completion of at least twenty-four (24) credits of continuing education relevant to psychology, approved by the Board, and completed over the two (2) year period preceding renewal of licensure.
